## Librerias

```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, mice, knitr, validate, deducorrect, VIM, GGally)
```
## Cargar datos

```{r}
datos <- read.delim(
  "data/NosAutoanalizamos2022 - Hoja1.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 25,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

datos %>% filter(!is.na(Id) & Id != "")
```

# Limpieza

```{r}
datos <- datos %>% filter(Id != "martsobm")

asignaturas <- c("ALG", "ANM", "FP", "DCS", "MD")

limpiar_nota <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x)
  x[x == "NC"] <- "3"
  x[x %in% c("NP", "NA", "N/A", "")] <- NA
  return(as.numeric(x))
}

datos[asignaturas] <- lapply(datos[asignaturas], limpiar_nota)
```
